JUST IN: 

PIZZA HUT WAS JUST SOLD TO PRIVATE EQUITY

Yum Brands $YUM has agreed to sell Pizza Hut for $2.7 Billion

- Pizza Hut outside of China goes to LongRange Capital for $1.5 billion.
- Pizza Hut in China goes to Yum China $YUMC for $1.2 billion.

The board also approved a new $4 billion share buyback authorization.

After the deal closes, Yum! will no longer report a Pizza Hut division ... KFC and Taco Bell are the focus from here.
